pages.title: Build a protective dome
pages.text: A Forcefield Generator creates a spherical shield. Set its radius and redstone mode in the hologram, then supply both flux types.$(br2)Larger fields cost more: a radius of 10 needs $(thing)300 of each flux per tick$() just to stay active. Building and repairing panels need extra power.

pages.title: Leave power for repairs
pages.text: Projectiles damage panels and can leave temporary holes. Changing the radius starts rebuilding.$(br2)Active panels are dangerous to cross without matching immunity. Keep a safe approach while testing.$(br2)Slow repairs can mean too little spare flux. Increase both supplies beyond the field’s idle demand.
